<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 101

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Knuckle Duster](/Weapons.aspx?ID=185)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Acid drips from the [ankhrav](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2822) mandibles protruding from this _[+1](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [knuckle duster](/Weapons.aspx?ID=185)_. Strikes with this weapon deal an additional 1 acid damage.

**Activate—Caustic Jabs** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Until the end of your next turn, your [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with the ankhrav duster deal an additional 1d6 [persistent acid damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the mandibles of an [ankhrav](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2822).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
